command.opencraft.help: /opencraft ask <message> — chat with your nearest AI assistant; /opencraft summon — summon one (binds the nearest unbound block); /opencraft dismiss [all] — dismiss nearest/all; /opencraft status — list all assistants; /opencraft reset [all] — clear nearest/all memory. Right-click an AI Logo Block to configure it in-game; each block binds at most one assistant, and you can have many at once.
